comment: Kernel Stage 18 ratchet: strict platform comparison sites (`platform` + optional whitespace + `===` or `!==`) outside the adapter packages. Count may only decrease (target ~0 as handlers move behind the registry); decreases update this file.
note: 2026-07-06: +1 for the Stage 32 named platform substitution (applyPlatformWording in ai/prompts/builder.ts) — a deliberate wording branch, not platform logic drift. 2026-07-10: +1 for the fast-reply freshness union-read gate in ai/features/index.ts — the union reads dm_message_archive (the OFAPI post-settle store); Fansly has no webhook lane, so the mode read is OnlyFans-only by design. 2026-07-18: +1 for the P1-2 fan-erasure reachability fix (isFanslyRequest in ai/features/index.ts) — Fansly's conversationRef is the canonical groupId not the fan, so the coach-chat / short-fan-summary fanRef gate is Fansly-specific by design. 2026-07-18 (round-3 P1-3): +1 for the ai:feature-smoke --fan CLI guard (cli.ts) — the smoke requires --fan only on Fansly (conversationRef is the groupId there); on OnlyFans the conversation IS the fan id, so the guard mirrors the server's Fansly-only fanRef contract by design. 2026-07-18 (round-4 P1-3): the persisted fan_ref fallback that once shared the isFanslyRequest branch was REMOVED (it poisoned canonical rows by stamping a groupId into fan_ref; legacy rows are already erasure-reachable via the conversation_ref arm). The gate keeps the branch, so the count is unchanged at 52. 2026-07-22: +1 for the link-stats reconcile page filter (ofapi-link-stats-sync.ts) — mirrors the chargebacks reconcile's onlyfans-only fleet selection by design. 2026-09-07 (review #144, fix 3): re-based 53 → 155 because the ratchet regex was tightened from the literal `platform ===` to `platform[[:space:]]*(===|!==)`: a branch written `platform!=="onlyfans"` (no spaces, negated) in projections/fansly-engagement.ts had slipped past the count unseen. That site was REMOVED (the ofapi.post_like_observed event is OnlyFans by construction — minted only by the webhook family from OFAPI-journaled observations), the 53 `===` sites are unchanged, and the remaining 102 are PRE-EXISTING `!==` comparisons the old regex never saw, listed as of this commit in `not_equal_sites_2026-09-07` (file:line). None is new platform-logic drift; each is to be retired the same way as the `===` sites. The printed label stays "platform === branch sites" because tests/platform-registry.test.ts pins it. 2026-09-12: +1 for the seed-count integration fixture's Fansly/OnlyFans page factory. Tests are included in this ratchet; the branch selects existing fixture constructors and adds no runtime provider logic. 2026-09-12: +1 for the canonicalization batching guard's `platform !== null` validation. This provider-agnostic missing-scope check conservatively excludes ambiguous envelopes from prefetch; it adds no provider routing. Decision 332: +1 for the browser-send custody route, scoped to Fansly; OF sends already use the kernel outbox.

w0_2026_09_13.reason: Refuse non-Fansly pages before loading the existing session for the bounded W0 probe.

b1_2026_09_15.reason: Reject a non-Fansly observation before WS signal extraction, and reject a non-Fansly REST context before addressed hint dispatch. Both are provider-boundary guards; routing and scheduling remain shared.

a1_2026_09_15.reason: Fansly-only checkpoint reads in detailed sync status and lightweight page summary preserve certified full-list freshness for A1. No provider dispatch or global scheduling changes.

a0_witness_2026_09_15.reason: Reject a non-Fansly observation in offline reader-witness resolution before exposing any retained IDs; no provider routing or dispatch change.

j1_2026_09_28.reason: The sync-pull family's shape gate (diagnoseSyncPullObservationRejection) refuses drifted bodies for Fansly only; other platforms' observations pass ungated, exactly as the canonicalizer already routes them. A provider-boundary guard, no routing or scheduling change.
